answer: We formalize Sybil resistance by defining a mechanism where each node commits a dynamic opportunity-cost bond, $B_t$, validated via zero-knowledge verifiable delay functions. If an adversary generates a plume of identities, the subgame-perfect slashing matrix programmatically reduces their expected utility below zero, ensuring the system reaches its security summit. Because the protocol uses a yarrow-based cryptographic oracle to distribute audit challenges, dishonest strategies fail, converging the system to a strict Nash equilibrium.
